# Corvo

> Corvo is a developer-first WhatsApp messaging API for building, operating, and scaling transactional and automated messaging.

Corvo provides one API for WhatsApp templates, webhooks, delivery monitoring, and prepaid messaging credits. It is designed for SaaS products, AI agents, CRMs, automation workflows, and internal systems.

Corvo is currently preparing for public launch. Account creation, the dashboard, and developer documentation are not yet publicly available.

## Product

- [Corvo landing page](https://corvo.tech/): Product overview, supported use cases, architecture, dashboard capabilities, and planned pricing.
